description: The oneshader command line: compiles HLSL vertex, pixel and compute shaders to SPIR-V, MSL and WGSL with a DXC-compatible set of core flags, writes reflection as JSON and Make-style dependency files.

A lightweight, reflection-based object mapper with an AutoMapper-style configuration API. Supports convention-based and custom member mapping, reverse maps, nested objects, collections, lifecycle actions, configuration validation, dependency injection, and mapping onto existing instances.

Given/When/Then helpers for specifying Wolverine handlers and event-sourced slices with Bobcat: arrange events, act through a tracked session, and assert what was appended and cascaded, rendered as a specification.

Writes WolverineFx.Bobcat specifications, and the spec project around them, from an eventmodelers.ai board export: one specification per example on the board, bound to its Event Model slice. The write-specs command, next to Wolverine's scaffold.
